meta.name: glycoengineering
meta.description: Analyze and engineer protein glycosylation. Scan sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, and access curated glycoengineering tools (NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, GlycoWorkbench). For glycoprotein engineering, therapeutic antibody optimization, and vaccine design.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析蛋白质糖基化位点,辅助抗体与疫苗设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做治疗性抗体或疫苗的糖基化设计。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze protein glycosylation sites to support antibody and vaccine design.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you engineer glycosylation for therapeutic antibodies or vaccines.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能分析蛋白质糖基化:扫描 N-糖基化位点、预测 O-糖基化热点、修改序列添加或消除糖基化位点,并介绍 NetOGlyc、GlycoShield 等外部工具。
howto.when: 当你要求分析或设计蛋白糖基化时触发,比如优化抗体 Fc 糖基化、设计治疗性蛋白的糖基化位点、或在疫苗抗原上添加糖基屏蔽等。

say.text: 帮我扫描这段蛋白序列的 N-糖基化位点。
say.note: 返回位置、模体及上下文。

say.text: 把序列第 297 位的天冬酰胺突变成谷氨酰胺,消除糖基化位点。
预测这条序列的 O-糖基化热点。
say.note: 给出基于 S/T 密度的候选位点。

howto.what_en: Analyzes protein glycosylation: scans N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predicts O-glycosylation hotspots, adds/removes glycosylation sites via sequence mutations, and references external tools (NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, etc.).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to analyze or engineer protein glycosylation, e.g., optimizing antibody Fc glycans, designing glycosites for therapeutic proteins, or engineering glycan shields in vaccine antigens.

say_en.text: Scan this protein sequence for N-glycosylation sites.
Mutate Asn at position 297 to Gln to remove the glycosylation site.
Predict O-glycosylation hotspots in this sequence.
say_en.note: Lists candidate sites from S/T density.
